comment: One entry per video/reel. media_id is the Instagram media ID of the video (find it in Meta's Graph API Explorer or in the webhook payload). trigger is the word a customer comments. Change the trigger word per video any time — just edit this file and restart the server. meetingType is the calendar event title, durationMinutes is the meeting length, questions are the two qualifying questions the agent asks in the DM, in order.

questions: What kind of insurance are you looking for — life, auto, or home?
When would be a good time for a quick call this week?
How many cars do you need covered?
Are you looking to switch soon, or just comparing prices?
Who would you like the policy to protect — just you, or your family too?
Have you had life insurance before?
